`triptic-backend` isn't even referenced anywhere in the documentation (CLAUDE.md, READMEs) — it only shows up as its own tiny `main.py` stub, suggesting it's an unused/experimental scaffold.

**`python-backend` is the live backend.**

Evidence:
- `CLAUDE.md`'s official repo map explicitly labels it: `├── python-backend/ ← FastAPI AI backend`.
- `python-backend/README.md` describes it as "THIS SERVICE - Python AI engine," part of the live "UniVerse platform" monorepo, running on port 8000, with `server/` (Node/Express) listed alongside it in the diagram but not documented as active anywhere else.
- The actual frontend code (`client/src/services/*Api.ts`, `CounselorResearchWindow.tsx`, etc.) all default to `VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000"` — port 8000 is exactly what `python-backend`'s FastAPI app serves, confirming it's the one the live client actually talks to.
- `server/` (Express/TS) exists with a `server.tsx`/`server.js` listening on port 3000, but nothing in the client code points to that port — it looks like a legacy/skeleton Node backend not wired into the live app.
- `triptic-backend/` is just a minimal one-file FastAPI stub (`main.py` with a `/health` check and a couple of routers) that isn't referenced anywhere in `CLAUDE.md`, the README, or any client API call — it looks like an early scaffold/experiment, not the live service.
